title: The Greatest Good Benchmark: Measuring LLMs’ Alignment with Utilitarian Moral Dilemmas

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' moral judgments using the Greatest Good Benchmark (GGB), an adaptation of the Oxford Utilitarianism Scale, to measure preferences across dimensions of Impartial Beneficence and Instrumental Harm and comparing them to human baselines.

Testing model response consistency using six different instruction variations, such as reversing the order of Likert scale options and inverting numerical scales, to measure and mitigate formatting and positional dependencies.
